title.narrative: Support to Justice Sector Reforms and Digitalization in Ukraine (PRAVO-JUSTICE II)

description.narrative: The Overall Objective is to support national authorities in strengthening the Rule of Law system in Ukraine and in aligning Ukrainian justice system with the best European and international practices. Specific Objectives: SO 1: Management of justice sector reforms improved in terms of strategic planning, coordination, monitoring and evaluation of reform implementation in the sector SO 2: Independence, efficiency, quality, integrity and transparency of the judiciary, and access to a fair trial enhanced SO 3: Enforcement of court decisions enhanced in civil and criminal cases SO 4: Justice sector digitisation policy instruments and e-justice solutions implemented
